subject: Request to shift Redwood demo time — travel & final QA
messages:
From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@olivelabs.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Berg <markus@olivelabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request to shift Redwood demo time — travel & final QA

Hi Grace,

Quick note — our execs just had a travel conflict come up for the 11/10 demo you had penciled in. Markus and I would prefer if we could move the session later in the week (11/12 or 11/13) so our CPO can attend in person. We also realized we need an extra 48 hours to finalize the prompt set and extract a small trace of typical workload to share with you so your team can run a more realistic dry run.

Two asks from our side:
- Can we shift the public demo to 11/12 or 11/13 in the afternoon PT?
- Is it possible to add a 60–90 minute dry run the day before the demo for Redwood/SEs to validate ingest and prompt behavior?

I attached the sample schema we were planning to use (sample-schema.csv). We can also provide a short workload trace if you want a specific format. Let me know what you need from us to make this move smooth.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Miller
Director of ML Product
Olive Labs
[Attachment: sample-schema.csv (CSV, 14KB)]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift Redwood demo time — travel & final QA

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and the sample schema. Moving the demo is totally doable. Proposed plan below so everyone has clarity:

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Thu 2026-11-12, 1:30–2:30pm PT (demo) with 
  - Wed 2026-11-11, 3:00–4:30pm PT (dry run / technical validation)
- Option B: Fri 2026-11-13, 11:00am–12:00pm PT (demo) with 
  - Thu 2026-11-12, 2:00–3:30pm PT (dry run)

Action items from Redwood: 
- Ben/SE team will validate the sample schema and ingestion flow in the dry run.
- We will circulate a short dryrun-checklist.pdf to document ports, sample payloads, and credentials needed ahead of the dry run.
- Vivek will coordinate exec seats and make sure we have the right presentation plan if the CPO attends live.

Sara — can you confirm which option you prefer and whether Markus will join the dry run? If you have a preferred time window different than the above, we can accommodate. Once you confirm, I will lock the calendar and send invites.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0189
[Attachment: dryrun-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Miller <sara.miller@olivelabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift Redwood demo time — travel & final QA

Grace / Sara — quick technical note from the SE side. Sara, thanks for the sample-schema.csv — I reviewed it and a couple of small asks so the dry run is productive: 

1) Can you place a 500–1,000 request trace (anonymized) in the same folder or provide a short JSONL with 50 representative examples? We use that to sanity-check token counts and latency under realistic inputs.
2) Please share either an S3 read-only path (recommended) or create a secure Google Drive folder and share editor access to ben_carter@redwood.com.
3) If you have any field-level encryption or PII redaction policy, include a brief note in the folder (we'll respect it).

I pushed a very short mutual-action-plan.xlsx to our shared Drive (link below). It outlines the dry run checklist, success criteria, and acceptance gates for the demo day. If we can close these items 48 hours before the demo, the team will be ready to present the workload trace end-to-end.

Suggested final schedule (per Grace's options):
- We prefer Option A (Thu 11/12 demo) so our East Coast SEs can join the dry run on Wed 11/11 afternoon PT.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-dryrun-assets (mutual-action-plan.xlsx uploaded)

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)]
From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@olivelabs.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Berg <markus@olivelabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift Redwood demo time — travel & final QA

Grace / Ben — thanks, all. Option A works best for us. Confirming:
- Dry run: Wed 2026-11-11, 3:00–4:30pm PT (Ben + SEs attending)
- Demo: Thu 2026-11-12, 1:30–2:30pm PT (Markus and our CPO will join in person)

I've uploaded a 60-request anonymized JSONL trace to the shared Drive and created a read-only S3 bucket link for the full 800-request trace per Ben's request (link in the Drive). Folder includes a short notes.txt describing the PII redaction.

Markus — flag if you want a 30-minute pre-brief the morning of the demo for any exec-level talking points.

Grace — please send the calendar invites and we will accept. Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Sara Miller
Director of ML Product
Olive Labs
